title: Projective-line adjunction for a normalized Tate datum
statement: Let $\Lambda$ be a finite commutative ring with a normalized Tate datum as specified below. Let $S$ be any scheme [def-pc-scheme] admitting a positive integer $n$ with $n\Lambda=0$ and $n$ invertible on $S$. For the projection $q:\mathbf P^1_S\to S$ [def-nagata-projective-space-base-change], on the ordinary unbounded etale derived categories of module sheaves [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories] there exists an adjunction $Rq_*\dashv Lq^*\mathbin{;}\operatorname{twistShift}_{\mathbf P^1_S}(1)$. The homogeneous coordinates are $\operatorname{Option}(\operatorname{ULift}(\operatorname{Fin}(1)))$. No Noetherian, boundedness or constructibility assumption is imposed on the base or the variable complexes. Here a normalized Tate datum means the adopted-source HasTateTwist and HasTateTwist.IsNormalized parameters: for every scheme $X$ and integer $m$, a tensor-invertible bounded constructible finite-Tor object $\Lambda_X(m)$, represented by a locally constant rank-one module sheaf in degree zero; zero, addition and derived-pullback isomorphisms, with the unit, associativity, pullback-composition and pullback-product laws. It underlies natural multiplicative Kummer classes $\kappa(u):\Lambda_X\to\Lambda_X(1)[1]$ whose coordinate boundary for $\mathbf A^1_B$, after adjunction to its zero section $s$, is an isomorphism $\Lambda_B\to Rs^!(\Lambda(1)[2])$ for every $B$ separated and locally of finite type over a field. The functor $\operatorname{twistShift}_X(m)$ is $K\mapsto(K\otimes^L\Lambda_X(m))[2m]$.

source.place: Diagonal-kernel unit, projection-formula counit, and both triangle identities, transported to the normalized source-library twist datum.

proof.text: Choose N>0 annihilating Lambda and invertible on S from HasInvertibleExponent. For P in the specified coordinates, invertibility pulls back along q:P->S. Apply [lem-sp-normalized-tate-line-comparison] to P, obtaining e from the given tateObject to the single complex of the concrete finite-root line.

Obtain t,d,hbc,hi from the existing arbitrary-base finite splitting and integral theorem [lem-sp-tower-p1-arbitrary-base-integrals]. Apply [lem-sp-finite-p1-adjunction-of-integrals] to this data at S to obtain the concrete finite-line adjunction.

The bifunctor derivedTensor.flip sends e inverse to a natural isomorphism from tensoring on the right with the concrete line to tensoring on the right with the given Tate object. Whisker it with shiftFunctor(2), then with Lq^*. Transport the concrete adjunction by Adjunction.ofNatIsoRight. Unfolding tateTwist and twistShift identifies its right adjoint with the unchanged requested functor.

proof_origin.place: Factor the normalized-datum comparison from the concrete diagonal-kernel assembly, then explicitly whisker the coefficient isomorphism and transport the adjunction.

mathlib_searches.query: Projective line etale derived direct image is left adjoint to pullback twisted by a normalized Kummer Tate datum shifted by two
mathlib_searches.results: Eight ordinary sheaf/structure-module pullback adjunction hits, including Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction and SheafOfModules.PullbackConstruction.adjunction; none supplies projective-line etale twisted duality.

Six hits: opensFunctorAdjunction, GammaSpec, kerAdjunction, algGammaAlgSpecAdjunction, Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction, Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction. None is a twisted etale derived projective-line adjunction.

Mathlib hits concern preservation of projective objects, not projective-space duality. Existing ProjectiveLineFullAdjunction and SfAffineBaseP1TraceAdjunction use explicit finite Tate coefficients, the former also a Noetherian base; neither accepts an arbitrary normalized HasTateTwist datum. Source AffineSpaceAdjunction is the parent, not an input.

from.place: Proof, first paragraph: invoke the projective-line adjunction before composing with the open-chart adjunction.

lean.statement:
theorem nonempty_normalizedProjectiveLineAdjunction
    (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] [Finite Λ] [HasTateTwist Λ]
    [HasTateTwist.IsNormalized Λ] (S : Scheme.{u}) [HasInvertibleExponent Λ S] :
    Nonempty (R((ℙ(Option (ULift.{u} (Fin 1)); S) ↘ S)_*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ]) ⊣
      L((ℙ(Option (ULift.{u} (Fin 1)); S) ↘ S)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ]) ⋙
        twistShift Λ ℙ(Option (ULift.{u} (Fin 1)); S) 1)
